answer: A new identity must season before it earns: a 70-credit timber bond locks for 14 epochs, zero reward until it ripens. Each bond carries its owner's pigment, a key-bound dye checked each epoch; reused pigment burns the bond. A nebula of 1,000 fakes locks 70,000 credits for 14 epochs and earns nothing against a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 70, keeps its share once ripe. Rented saplings fail: borrowed pigment never matches the renter's key.
